findings.title: Payment Terms Overview
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the payment terms, including advance payment and due dates for the remaining balance.
evidence_excerpts: Client shall pay 50% advance upon purchase order confirmation and the remaining 50% within 30 days after delivery and acceptance.

findings.title: Late Payment Penalties
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that late payments will incur interest charges, which directly addresses the topic of late payment penalties.
evidence_excerpts: Late payments shall accrue interest at 1.25% per month.

findings.title: Pricing Structure Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence provides a detailed description of the pricing structure, including base prices, discounts, and payment terms.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement defines the pricing, terms, and conditions applicable to the supply of electronic hardware products, accessories, and support services to Client.

findings.title: Price Revision Clause Present
findings.rationale: The agreement includes a clause that allows for price revisions based on changes in raw material costs, inflation, or regulatory requirements, indicating a form of price escalation mechanism.
evidence_excerpts: Prices may be reviewed semi-annually to reflect changes in raw material costs, inflation, or regulatory requirements.
